summary.name: Rewind.ai
summary.one_liner: Rewind.ai is a web hub offering access to 400+ AI chat, image, audio, and video models, reachable through a single OpenAI-compatible API.
use_cases: Try multiple AI models without separate sign-ups
Generate images or video with AI
Chat with AI models and upload files
Call many AI models through one API
Prototype AI features from cURL, Python or Node.js
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a collection of over 400 AI models for chat, image, audio and video, most of which can be used without signing up. It offers an advanced AI chat feature with chat history and file upload. A developer API is offered that is described as OpenAI-compatible, giving access to all listed tools through one REST endpoint, with code examples shown for cURL, Python and Node.js. The page also lists a pricing section with paid plans that renew monthly and mentions an option to start free.
notable: Single OpenAI-compatible REST API covering 400+ models
Chat with history and file upload
Code examples for cURL, Python and Node.js
caveats: Paid plans renew monthly; higher usage requires payment
Some models are reached through external providers
Page does not describe detailed limits of free tier
